enchantments.tooltip: +5 Enhancement Bonus: +5 enhancement bonus to Armor Class.
Fortification +108%: +108% Enhancement bonus to reduced chance of taking critical damage on a critical hit.
Quality Fortification +26%: +26% Quality bonus to reduced chance of taking critical damage on a critical hit.
Healing Amplification: This effect amplifies all incoming positive energy healing by +10 (Exceptional bonus). Includes spells, potions, and other effects.

Greater Nimbleness: This suit of armor looks much less restrictive than others of its type. A suit of armor that has this property has a maximum Dexterity bonus 2 higher than normal, and its armor check penalty is reduced by 4.
Mythic Armor Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
